finding.summary: V6 persists a create-once PREPARED crash-reconciliation intent before entering V4. V4 may then raise RuntimeCycleNotDue before any grid10_cognitive_cycles row is committed. Scheduler-v2 catches RuntimeCycleNotDue and returns NOT_DUE, but V6 does not terminalize the already-written intent. The result can be a durable PREPARED intent representing ordinary cadence rather than a crash window.
finding.why_it_matters: A PREPARED row is part of the crash/recovery observability substrate. Leaving ordinary NOT_DUE attempts in PREPARED can inflate apparent unresolved recovery work and blur expected cadence with interruption evidence. It also leaves cleanup/reconciliation to a later recovery mutator even though the originating process already knows the exact expected control-flow exit.
finding.related_prior_evidence: The retired V7 lane already identified the same semantic class: expected RuntimeCycleNotDue must not be typed as crash-like recovery UNKNOWN. V7 was retired in favor of the tighter V6 lane, so the invariant must be closed in V6 rather than reintroducing V7.

hypothesis: When V4 raises RuntimeCycleNotDue after V6 has written PREPARED and before a V4 cycle row exists, the current V6 caller should terminalize only that exact attempt as ABORTED_BEFORE_V4_COMMIT (or an equivalently explicit NOT_DUE terminal state) and then re-raise RuntimeCycleNotDue unchanged to scheduler policy.
counterhypothesis: All PREPARED rows may intentionally be left for later reconciliation even for expected NOT_DUE control flow. If that is intended, dashboards/recovery scans must mechanically exclude no-V4 expected-NOT_DUE attempts; otherwise PREPARED ceases to be a high-signal crash-window indicator.
safety_constraints: Do not mark CLOSED; no V6 receipt exists.
Do not claim provider-call evidence beyond the ordering invariant.
Do not mutate a PREPARED row if a V4 cycle or V6 closure has appeared.
Do not require or consume provider/model credentials.
Do not create a new recovery authority or revive the retired V7 lane.
Do not weaken canonical recovery-lease requirements for post-crash mutation.

cheapest_discriminator.test: Seed one active goal, execute one normal scheduler-v2 heartbeat to commit next_tick_not_before, then call cycle_once with a fresh cycle/tick id before that due time. Assert scheduler returns NOT_DUE; no second grid10_cognitive_cycles row exists; the second V6 intent is terminal ABORTED_BEFORE_V4_COMMIT or explicit NOT_DUE; terminal_ts/classification are present; no V6 closure exists; same-tick retry remains unauthorized; provider/model calls remain zero.

implementation_shape: Add one narrow pre-V4 expected-exit terminalization helper in grid10_v6_crash_reconciliation_v1.py that CAS-updates only PREPARED with verified absence of the V4 cycle and V6 closure.
Catch RuntimeCycleNotDue around the V4 call in grid10_cognitive_unified_runtime_v6.py, invoke that helper, then re-raise the original RuntimeCycleNotDue.
Add a deterministic scheduler-v2 regression for active-goal early cadence invocation.
Keep post-V4 crash recovery mutation behind the existing canonical exclusive lease; this expected in-process pre-V4 closure is not a substitute for recovery authority.
next_exact_gate: Implement the narrow V6 expected-NOT_DUE terminalization plus deterministic regression on the existing V6/scheduler-v2 lane, without touching the two queued singleton runtime generations. Separately, restore/assign the existing authorized self-hosted Linux/X64 runner so issues 2122 and 2121 can execute; do not replace or duplicate them.
